topNews.text: Sumatran Tiger Cubs Born in the UK Is Huge Win–with Only 400 Left in Wild
topNews.excerpt: In a valuable milestone for the conservation of the Sumatran tiger subspecies, 3 cubs born to a UK zoo have grown old enough to venture out from the maternity den into the enclosure.
